name: southriver-web_composer
description: Compose template for the South River web shell (RokctAI/southriver-web, app_type southriver-web): a Next.js shell with no backend, so it carries no frappe modules - only the sdks[] the Next.js composer reads
_comment: The first Next.js-only registry template: RokctAI/southriver-web is a thin shell (a one-line .rokct/config/app_type naming this template) with NO backend - it runs base_sdk's local data mode, reading its site content from the shell's own data/ folder - so modules[] is empty on purpose and there is no rcore app behind it. sdks[] is the kernel (telemetry_sdk, base_sdk) plus corporate_sdk for the company pages. NO auth_sdk: there is no backend to sign in to, so the /login and /register routes and the NextAuth session seam have nothing to talk to. NO lms_sdk or any other product SDK. No home SDK yet (no entry carries home_sdk: true, so base_sdk's landing host serves the shell in composer.json order): the South River home SDK is added to this template later, directly behind base_sdk, when it exists. Data mode is not a template concern - the shell's own composer.json carries its "data" key.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570 (git blob 7020b16a, 1074 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The base SDK's nextjs half (core#160): the platform kernel — app/services/base (platform gateway, tenant hosts, session, telemetry), the base admin content/settings/system actions and pages, the manager shell, the shared app sidebar, nav-user/team-switcher, date-range-picker and use-mobile, and (base_sdk >= 1.35.0) the lib/site-data reader and generate.mjs bundler behind the shell's local data mode. Composed here because telemetry_sdk 'requires' app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts, which only this half installs. Its own 'requires' names host-owned files (lib/utils.ts, the components/ui primitives, components/custom/branding.tsx, app/config/*, app/lib/*) plus merchants_sdk's shop action and merchant-nav and auth_sdk's app/lib/session.ts — warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install; the southriver-web shell provides the host-owned half, and with no auth_sdk composed the session seam resolves to null (the local-mode shell has no signed-in surface).

sdks.name: corporate_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of corporate/nextjs/install.py at corporate@c411ef5 (git blob 915470a4, 1103 bytes; the same installer text as polaris/nextjs with sdk_name corporate_sdk); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The corporate SDK's nextjs half (corporate_sdk 1.0.0): the company pages - in 1.0.0 the legal pages, app/legal (the index of the shell's published "Terms and Conditions" documents) and app/legal/[id] (one document, server-rendered, 404 when missing or disabled), the renderer and frame under components/custom/legal and the guest read app/actions/corporate/legal.ts. Composed here for the South River company pages (legal now; the about / team pages and the data/ fallback that corporate_sdk 1.1.0 adds once base 1.35.0 lands are what a local-mode shell serves them from). Listed directly after base_sdk - there is no auth_sdk in this template - because its 'requires' names files base_sdk >= 1.34.0 installs (app/actions/base/legal.ts listPublicTerms, components/custom/landing/legal-links.ts, the FooterChromeConfig.links seam on footer-chrome-config.ts / footer-chrome.tsx, app/lib/site-metadata.ts, the platform gateway) plus the host-owned app/config/platform.ts - warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install. Never home (home_sdk false). No dependencies or integrations of its own: the routes are file-convention pages.
